description: This file defines an internal interface and a class for managing broadcast channel consumers within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for handling errors and published items, and manages stream callbacks and subscriptions.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelConsumerExtension
classes.description: Manages callbacks and subscriptions for broadcast channel streams, providing methods to handle errors and message publications.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles stream error events by invoking the respective callback.

methods.name: OnPublished
methods.description: Handles stream message publication events by invoking the respective callback.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a callback handler for a specific stream identified by streamId.

methods.name: GetStreamCallback
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a callback for a specific stream, establishing a subscription if needed.
